Owl Valley — Enhanced Environmental Motion

A non-wired, standalone preview of five cinematic motion refinements layered over the real Owl Valley background asset. Nothing here is connected to the live application.

Owl · See
To see clearly,
you must leave
the cave.
Freezes / drastically slows all ambient animation — demonstrates prefers-reduced-motion support absent from the current app.
1. River current
Flow follows the river's actual bends from cave to foreground; narrow bend sections run faster/more turbulent, wide calm stretches run slower.
2. Moonlight glints
Soft specular blobs drift slowly along the water, changing shape via two slow incommensurate oscillations so they never look like a static sheen or an obvious loop.
3. Layered fog
Distant / mid / near fog bands drift at different speeds and opacities for parallax depth.
4. Leaf / branch sway
Foreground foliage near the owl's perch rotates a few degrees with slow, non-repeating easing.
5. Cave mist
Warm wisps near the cave mouth drift and pulse gently to suggest depth without becoming a visual effect in itself.
Prototype only — src/components/AtmosphereCanvas.tsx was not modified. Background asset: /public/bg-owl-main.png (embedded as base64, not a placeholder).
